question: Article 356 and 360 in the Indian constitution are the articles based on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**emergency provisions.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 356** is related to the** imposition of President's Rule** in a state, which is a form of** emergency provision** used when the state government is unable to function properly.
 
• **Article 360** deals with the** financial emergency** that can be imposed in the country when the financial stability or credit of India is threatened.
 
• The emergency provisions in the Indian constitution are of three types -** national emergency, state emergency, and financial emergency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regional languages** are not directly related to either Article 356 or 360, although language can be a factor in the** imposition of President's Rule** in a state.
 
• **Amendment of the constitution** is not related to these articles, as it is covered under a separate set of articles in the constitution.
